**What are you trying to get done?** Describe the situation, not the feature.

**What do you do today instead?**

**How would you know it worked?** If there is no way to tell, say so — this project treats "no declared way to verify it" as its own outcome, not as a pass.

**Is this blocked by one of the known limitations?** (see the Limitations section of the README)
